empirical_modules.notes: Uses integrated_io_atlas.h5ad and GSE206325 metadata to derive abundance, DEG, and signature comparisons.
Pseudo-bulk GSE173905 logic is real-data driven; optional HCC_omics Visium branch depends on external files not committed here.
Reference matrix generation is empirical; actual trial deconvolution requires missing bulk matrices.
Internal validation, bootstrap, and pathway analyses are built from the integrated atlas and derived tables.
